newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares edge up, with eyes on French vote.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares edge up, with eyes on French vote.

text.p: Danish share prices edged up in early Thursday trade on a generally hesitant market ahead of Sunday's second round vote in the French elections.
"If the Socialists win it could well be the starting signal for new uncertainty regarding the EMU process. That cannot fail to affect European financial markets," a dealer said.
At 0745 GMT the KFX top-20 index was up 0.07 point from Wednesday's close, at 165.92.
Its June future rose 0.25 point, to 165.60. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
